note: Both sets correctly capture the two annotated Figure 7-3 values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0 = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336°) and the doubling relation, but both are padded with heavy duplication and several unsupported graph reads. Set A includes a clearly wrong read (-90E+6 at the last data point, which is about -120E+6) plus two -30E+6 claims at θ=0 that contradict the annotated -25.52E+6, and it states the doubling relation with the wrong condition ('at rated operating point' instead of at θK). Set B has one wrong read (-105E+6 at the maximum plotted pitch angle) and one rough read (-110E+6 at 20°), but its θ=0 read (-25E+6) is consistent with the annotation, its relation claim carries the correct condition, and it adds the supported fact that the pitch-sensitivity/blade-pitch relation is linear in Region 3.
